description: Quick-start example of docs/METHOD_PREFLIGHT.md; hypothetical rules, not LLM evidence.
prediction_source: Derived from the rules in docs/METHOD_PREFLIGHT.md. Object wins only with strictly more points under the value-transfer hypothesis. The toy example stipulates donor baselines (60/10 chooses Object, 60/90 Alternative) and recipient baselines (20/40 and 20/80 choose Alternative); real studies must measure both. Value transfer: donor Object value versus recipient Alternative value. Choice transfer: donor's observed choice. Forced Object: always Object. The legacy key no_effect means recipient answer preserved on this readout, not an internally inactive patch.
